findings.detail: Oracle source-side count appears to include the separate December 31, 2024 comparative investment schedule instead of scoping only to December 31, 2025.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The filing's current-period schedule total is 359.400 million and the current 2025 investments-by-type table reports 455 portfolio company investments. The immediately separate comparative 2024 table reports 465 investments. The flagged source value of 927 is therefore not supported as the current-period population; it is consistent with an oracle source-side comparative-period leak, while the output value of 460 is close to the current 2025 investment population and does not show a grounded missing-current-data defect. Raw source decides the issue as a false alarm in the E07 check.
